steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each control in each process is matched to its recorded result.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Control with no result
findings.fix: Run the control and record the result

outcome.notChecked: Whether the controls were run as written; processes not audited.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] process-picking.md:12  Control with no result.
       Fix: Run the control and record the result.
[medium] process-dispatch.md:19  Finding with no action.
       Fix: Name the action.
[low] process-billing.md:26  Action with no due date.
       Fix: Set the due date.
Not checked: Whether the controls were run as written; processes not audited.
pros: Checks a control with no result, a finding with no action, and an action with no owner or due date.
cons: Not checked: Whether the controls were run as written; processes not audited.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-process-audit skill on the records for this review.
